package domain

import "errors"

// Shared domain errors.
var (
	ErrDiagnosticContextStale = errors.New("diagnostic_context_stale")
	ErrNotFound               = errors.New("not found")
	ErrForbidden              = errors.New("forbidden")
	ErrConflict               = errors.New("conflict")
	ErrInvalidStatus          = errors.New("invalid status")
	ErrValidation             = errors.New("validation error")
	ErrMaxAttempts            = errors.New("max attempts exceeded")
	ErrAlreadyReviewed        = errors.New("answer already reviewed")
	ErrAnswerNotInProgress    = errors.New("answer not in progress")
	ErrSandboxNotFound        = errors.New("sandbox not found for this answer; restart the task")
	ErrTaskLocked             = errors.New("task is locked until previous lesson or task is completed")
	ErrMilestoneLocked        = errors.New("milestone locked")
	ErrEvidenceContract       = errors.New("learning evidence contract violation")
	ErrStateChanged           = errors.New("student state changed")
	ErrActivePathExists       = errors.New("active learning path exists")
	ErrReservationConflict    = errors.New("onboarding path reservation conflict")
	ErrReservationExpired     = errors.New("onboarding path reservation expired")
	ErrFeatureDisabled        = errors.New("feature disabled")
)

type MilestoneLockedError struct {
	StudentPracticeTaskID          string
	StudentPracticeTaskMilestoneID string
	BlockingReason                 string
	Prerequisites                  MilestonePrerequisites
}

func (errorValue *MilestoneLockedError) Error() string {
	return ErrMilestoneLocked.Error()
}

func (errorValue *MilestoneLockedError) Unwrap() error {
	return ErrMilestoneLocked
}
